title: CLEANUP: replace WP11_PROTO_PIV placeholder for flash slots with WP11_PROTO_FLASH
description: src/wp11_pkcs11.c line ~388: flash slots have proto set to WP11_PROTO_PIV with a comment 'placeholder; flash uses keystore protocol'. Any future code that dispatches on slot->proto will incorrectly handle flash slots as PIV tokens. Fix: add WP11_PROTO_FLASH (or WP11_PROTO_KEYSTORE) to the wp11_proto_t enum in the appropriate header. Use it for flash slots. Remove the misleading placeholder comment and replace with a doc comment explaining that flash slots have no APDU protocol — they use the keystore path in C_Login/C_Sign/C_Verify/C_Decrypt instead of the CCID dispatch.
